schema.help: For example a car door opening suddenly, a vehicle cutting across you, or a junction where you can't see what's coming.

options.text: Not at all: I feel unprepared
A little: I know the risks, but they often catch me out
Fairly: I manage most, but some still worry me
Quite: I see most dangers coming and react well
Very: I feel ready for the usual dangers

schema.text: How confident are you that you can react in time to danger on the bike?

ar.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: قليلًا: أعرف المخاطر، لكنها تفاجئني كثيرًا
ar.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: إلى حد ما: أتعامل مع معظمها، لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#For example a car door opening suddenly: مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة، أو مركبة تقطع طريقك، أو تقاطع لا ترى فيه ما هو قادم.
ar.#How confident are you that you can reac: ما مدى ثقتك بأنك تستطيع التصرف في الوقت المناسب أمام الخطر أثناء ركوب الدراجة؟
ar.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: بدرجة جيدة: أرى معظم المخاطر قبل وقوعها وأتصرف جيدًا

de.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Wenig: Ich kenne die Gefahren, aber sie überraschen mich oft
de.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Einigermaßen: Ich komme mit den meisten zurecht, aber manche machen mir noch Sorgen
de.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Zum Beispiel eine plötzlich aufgehende Autotür, ein Fahrzeug, das Ihnen den Weg abschneidet, oder eine Kreuzung, an der Sie nicht sehen, was kommt.
de.#How confident are you that you can reac: Wie sicher sind Sie, dass Sie auf dem Rad rechtzeitig auf Gefahren reagieren können?
de.#Not at all: I feel unprepared: Gar nicht: Ich fühle mich unvorbereitet
de.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Gut: Ich sehe die meisten Gefahren kommen und reagiere gut
de.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Sehr gut: Ich fühle mich auf die üblichen Gefahren vorbereitet

en.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: A little: I know the risks, but they often catch me out
en.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Fairly: I manage most, but some still worry me
en.#For example a car door opening suddenly: For example a car door opening suddenly, a vehicle cutting across you, or a junction where you can't see what's coming.
en.#How confident are you that you can reac: How confident are you that you can react in time to danger on the bike?
en.#Not at all: I feel unprepared: Not at all: I feel unprepared
en.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Quite: I see most dangers coming and react well
en.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Very: I feel ready for the usual dangers

fa.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: کمی: خطرها را می‌شناسم، اما اغلب غافلگیرم می‌کنند
fa.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: نسبتاً: بیشتر آن‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#For example a car door opening suddenly: مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، عبور ناگهانی وسیله‌ای از جلوی شما، یا تقاطعی که نمی‌توانید ببینید چه چیزی می‌آید.
fa.#How confident are you that you can reac: چقدر مطمئن هستید که روی دوچرخه می‌توانید به‌موقع در برابر خطر واکنش نشان دهید؟
fa.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: تا حد زیادی: بیشتر خطرها را پیش‌بینی می‌کنم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: بسیار: برای خطرهای معمول احساس آمادگی می‌کنم

fr.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Un peu : je connais les risques, mais ils me surprennent souvent
fr.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Assez : je gère la plupart, mais certains m'inquiètent encore
fr.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Par exemple une portière de voiture qui s'ouvre brusquement, un véhicule qui vous coupe la route ou un carrefour où vous ne voyez pas ce qui arrive.
fr.#How confident are you that you can reac: Dans quelle mesure êtes-vous sûr de pouvoir réagir à temps à un danger à vélo ?
fr.#Not at all: I feel unprepared: Pas du tout : je me sens mal préparé
fr.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Bien : je vois venir la plupart des dangers et je réagis bien
fr.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Très bien : je me sens prêt face aux dangers habituels

hu.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Egy kicsit: ismerem a veszélyeket, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Eléggé: a legtöbbet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtó, Ön elé bevágó jármű, vagy olyan kereszteződés, ahol nem látja, mi jön.
hu.#How confident are you that you can reac: Mennyire biztos benne, hogy a biciklin időben tud reagálni a veszélyre?
hu.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Meglehetősen: a legtöbb veszélyt előre látom, és jól reagálok
hu.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Nagyon: felkészültnek érzem magam a szokásos veszélyekre

it.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Poco: conosco i rischi, ma spesso mi colgono di sorpresa
it.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Abbastanza: me la cavo quasi sempre, ma alcuni pericoli mi preoccupano ancora
it.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Per esempio una portiera d'auto che si apre all'improvviso, un veicolo che ti taglia la strada o un incrocio dove non vedi cosa arriva.
it.#How confident are you that you can reac: Quanto sei sicuro di riuscire a reagire in tempo a un pericolo in bici?
it.#Not at all: I feel unprepared: Per niente: mi manca la preparazione
it.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Molto: vedo arrivare quasi tutti i pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Moltissimo: so affrontare i pericoli più comuni

tr.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Biraz: Riskleri bilirim ama çoğu zaman beni hazırlıksız yakalar
tr.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Oldukça: Çoğunu idare ederim ama bazıları hâlâ beni endişelendirir
tr.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Örneğin aniden açılan bir araba kapısı, önünüzden kesen bir araç veya ne geldiğini göremediğiniz bir kavşak.
tr.#How confident are you that you can reac: Bisikletteyken bir tehlikeye zamanında tepki verebileceğinizden ne kadar eminsiniz?
tr.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: İyi: Tehlikelerin çoğunu önceden görür ve iyi tepki veririm
tr.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Çok iyi: Olağan tehlikelere karşı kendimi hazır hissederim
